create_BisectingKMeans_cluster: create a BisectingKMeans clustering model with configurable n_clusters, init strategy, and bisecting strategy
run_BisectingKMeans_fit: run BisectingKMeans fit on training data with sample weights and optional validation
test_BisectingKMeans_predict: test BisectingKMeans predict by assigning new samples to hierarchical leaf clusters
build_hierarchical_clusters: build a hierarchical cluster tree using _BisectingTree with bisecting strategy based on inertia or cluster size
summarize_BisectingKMeans_inertia: summarize the inertia calculation per cluster for bisected subclusters using _inertia_per_cluster
